evidence: At 20.8-22.4 s the wrist view shows the knife held in the gripper and lowered onto the wooden cutting board. At 24.0 s the gripper has released it and the knife lies on the board in both shoulder views, where it stays through 25.6 s. The arm then moves over the plate, and at 25.6 s the wrist view shows the steak on the plate right below the gripper. The steak is not yet picked. This is normal progress into stage 2.
